description: Start a new SEO/UX scan (crawl) for one of the user's domains. Scans run asynchronously and usually take a few minutes; poll get_scan_status for progress and the resulting scores. If a scan is already in progress, its id is returned instead of starting a duplicate.

domainId.description: Domain id of one of the user's projects, as returned by list_domains.

name: run_scan
title: Run scan
